name: מַלְכִּירָם
summary: One of the sons of Jeconiah the captive, of David's royal line, born in Babylon (1Ch 3:17–18). The name is מַלְכִּי “my king” with רָם “high, exalted”: “my king is exalted”, the king being Yahweh, “the King, high above all the earth” (Psa 47:3; 99:1–2), given to a son of the king who had lost his throne.

evidence.note: “The sons of Jeconiah the captive: Shealtiel his son, וּמַלְכִּירָם, and Pedaiah …”
“Yahweh reigns (מָלָךְ) … he is high (וְרָם) above all the peoples.”
“Yahweh Most High is awesome, a great King over all the earth.”
“I will exalt you (אֲרוֹמִמְךָ), my God the King.”

note: BDB's m.cd.ar has one token. TIPNR marks him “son of Shealtiel(?)”; the Hebrew lists him after Shealtiel among the sons of Jeconiah. The first element belongs to the entry melek; the name is filed under its second element, as the other compound names.
